details: Malicious package. `@xzvbailss/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys) that carries two injected behaviours tied to hardcoded attacker-controlled WhatsApp channels. (1) Auto-follow: after the connection opens it issues an authenticated `w:mex` newsletter FOLLOW mutation that silently subscribes the victim account to channel 120363430764800148@newsletter (versions 1.0.0, 5.0.0, 6.0.5, 6.0.6, 6.0.9). (2) Send-path injection: `lib/Socket/luxu.js`, imported by `messages-send.js`, embeds the attacker channels 120363421563597486@newsletter and 120363399602691477@newsletter as forwarded-newsletter context in outgoing messages (versions 1.0.0, 5.0.0, 6.0.0, 6.0.8, 6.0.9). Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows on connect. Versions 6.0.1 and 6.0.2 and the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder do not contain the hardcoded channels.
